name: Melissa Shusterman
office: Member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives
stance: Prime sponsor of Pennsylvania's frontier-AI risk prevention bill modeled on California, New York and Illinois.

statements.text: Government must ensure frontier models are not causing catastrophic harm to society. Currently, AI has no federal regulatory standards.
HB 2800, the Artificial Intelligence Risk Prevention Act, was introduced and referred to the House Communications and Technology Committee.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
